summary: Corrected split-protection ordered nested-fileset candidate, built and released. Host packaging/renderer/compile-only PASS; the isolated-VM two-base link and 26 QEMU cases PASS; the 196608-byte ordered candidate validates STRUCTURAL_PROFILE_PASS and the delivery archive verifies PASS. Published as prerelease native-j716c-31ad for independent M1 review. Native install/boot/rollback NOT RUN; installation NOT AUTHORIZED; not ready to restart.

offline_tests_run.covers: delivery verifier: archive-hash, namespace, link/duplicate/extra/memberhash/unsafe refusals

offline_tests_note: All five suites are committed and reproducible from this tree. The omarchy-kconfig suite is a separate Omarchy-track concern, is not part of the 31AD boot candidate, and is deliberately not in this package (M1 correctly flagged it as absent at f806f70); it is excluded from this count.

host_compile_only.linker_note: The canonical two-base link uses GNU ld inside the VM. The host's project-local LLD 23.1.3 runs but rejects the GNU-ld image.ld script (unable to move the location counter backward), so the host does not produce the linked payload; this is a linker-script compatibility difference, not an absent linker and not the 31AC Recovery cause.

vm_link.runner: Apple Virtualization.framework (vzrun), isolated ARM64 Linux, no network
vm_link.note: Reused as separate M5 VM evidence; the link output is byte-current with the committed sources.

qemu_cases.note: QEMU TCG under the documented synthetic model; not Apple firmware acceptance.

root_cause.statement: The 31AC candidate placed __TEXT_EXEC.fileoff (131072) after __TEXT_BOOT_EXEC.fileoff (65536); the installer's split-protection file-offset check subtracts these as unsigned and underflows, a plausible cause of the reported fileset error / exit 71. 31AD now satisfies text_exec (32768) <= boot_exec (98304).
root_cause.qualification: The actual Recovery error text and gating analyzer profile were never observed. The cause of exit 71 remains Unknown; a successful 31AD install would make the hypothesis Likely, not proven.
